correctness_confidence.basis: Layer 1 Lean 4 kernel compiles with 0 sorry, 0 warnings, and 0 external dependencies. Layer 2 SPEC-GEOM-CERT-1.0 successfully audits all 16 exact-Q certificates without floats.

novelty.basis: Novel pairing of machine-checked Lean 4 geometry kernels with pure-stdlib Python rational auditors for asymptotic spectrum Euclidean embedding certificates.

reproducibility.basis: All 16 exact-Q certificates and 18 Lean theorems are fully specified, accompanied by replay scripts running in 0.071-0.313 ms.

rigor.basis: Comprehensive formalization of 2D rational Euclidean geometry, Pythagorean triples, translation/homogeneity invariance, Lagrange's identity, and strict CCW polygon convexity.

significance.basis: Bridges abstract tensor geometry and formal verification, establishing rigorous bounds for Euclidean mean width sharing discounts and collinear zero-excess.

potential_errors: Scope is explicitly restricted to 2D rational Euclidean geometry and scaled rotations/similarities, omitting general linear contractions and infinite-dimensional tensor-theoretic constructions.
strengths: Exemplary formal verification rigor in Lean 4 with zero axioms of choice, zero sorry statements, and zero warnings.
Self-contained pure-stdlib Python auditor (SPEC-GEOM-CERT-1.0) providing lightning-fast exact rational certificate replays.
Rigorous cross-checking against 4096-angle Cauchy-Crofton integration and robust adversarial forgery rejection.
strong_novelty_candidates: Two-layer machine-checked Lean 4 and exact-Q rational verification stack for asymptotic spectrum Euclidean embedding geometry.
summary: The paper presents an explicitly scoped, standalone, zero-floating-point verification stack pairing a 18-theorem Lean 4 kernel (AsymptoticSpectrumGeometry.lean) with a pure-stdlib Python rational auditor (SPEC-GEOM-CERT-1.0). It rigorously formalizes and audits 2D exact Euclidean geometry, Pythagorean parametrizations, scaled-rotation similarities, polygon mean-width W(S) = P/2 sharing discounts, and collinear zero-excess certificates over Q. All 16 canonical certificates verify successfully in 0.071-0.313 ms and reject all adversarial forgeries.
weaknesses: Excludes full formalization of infinite-dimensional tensor asymptotic spectra, convex hulls, and general linear contractions beyond 2D similarities.
